name: Ormándlak (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ormándlak (a blue shield with a figure holding a cross on a green mound) between the words ORMÁNDLAK above and KÖZSÉG ÖNKORMÁNYZATA below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
